newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco says USG cold cuts 300-400 mmcfd natgas.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco says USG cold cuts 300-400 mmcfd natgas.

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline said Tuesday that the recent cold wave on the U.S. Gulf Coast forced producers to shut in 300-400 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas on its system.
"Producers have shut in between 300 and 400 mmcfd on a system that transports about 7 bcfd (billion cubic feet per day)," a company spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said she expected a lot of the shut in gas to be restored later today as temperatures moderate, adding "We have more than adequate reserves in storage to cover that kind of loss."
